label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y hizo travesaños, maderas de shitím: cinco a las tablas del costado del mishkán el uno,
spanish: Y hizo travesaños maderas de acacia: cinco a las tablas del costado del tabernáculo el uno,
grammarChanges: Removed the comma between travesaños and maderas de acacia so the plural construct chain (bars of wood of acacia) reads as one material-apposition unit instead of two disconnected items.
Replaced the untranslated loan shitím with its Spanish equivalent acacia.
Replaced the untranslated loan mishkán with its Spanish equivalent tabernáculo.
readerNote: Kept masculine el uno because it agrees with the Spanish noun costado, matching the established parallel wording at Éxodo 26:32, even though the Hebrew cardinal הָאֶחָת is feminine.
